name: Lucius
source: King Lucius is one of the most powerful beings to have ever existed. He had conquered five of the seven realms but gave them back their independence after meeting his bond mate. He maintained his rule over Terran, where vampires, werewolves, and humans live. He is a strong leader and has a very strategic mind, but is often too cold or harsh for most people's liking. Despite his menacing exterior and his vampiric bloodlust, he can't resist but drink a strawberry smoothie each morning.
